title: Main's full CI run ends green, not cancelled
why: Finding, Oct 27 (c95 part 1): a milestone CI run is noise while most full runs never finish.
note: Measured Oct 27 at main 2ad85de (c96 thread), gates.yml push runs on main, Oct 13 to 27: 85 of 134 cancelled. All 85 were job timeouts, none a newer push: main runs have had their own concurrency group with no cancel-in-progress since Oct 10 (adc21ce, each main run gets its own group), and every cancelled job stopped at its cap then (Windows merge 83 at 20 min, Windows guard 38 at 15 min, Windows rest 16, macOS 5, others 5). The fix already landed: c61 (Windows jobs fit their caps, b55643d) split the guard and merge suites into shards. Since its first main run (Oct 26 15:21 UTC), 6 runs: 4 green, 1 red, 1 cancelled. Green maxima now sit well inside every cap (merge shards 10.2 of 15 min, guard shards 13.7 of 20, rest 22.6 of 38, macOS 29.2 of 50). The 2 later cancels were hangs, not slow suites, so a higher cap would not help: d741cd5 guard mutation harness (green max 3.7 min, cap 10), 3b96ce8 gates-shoot Chromium install (green max 0.5, cap 10) and Windows rest janitor triggers suite. No workflow change built. Open: main's latest run (2ad85de) is red on a real failure, the macOS stall watch fixture suite. Recommend closing c96 (triage's call). Placed ahead of c82, after c95 (triage, Oct 27): it blocks c95's pick. Needs no answer from you. Port: no; claude-settings' own workflows.
